data.name: Raheem
data.gender_notes: Raheem is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word ‘rahim’ meaning compassionate, merciful, or kind. In the Quran, it is the name of God associated with mercy and compassion. The name Raheem carries the meaning “Comforting, Merciful” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Raheem usually hope their child will grow to embody comforting, merciful and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Raheem belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Comforting, Merciful.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Raheem total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_hebrew.name: רחים
in_hebrew.long_meaning: שם האלוהים באהבה. השם רחים מקורו בהברה ר-ח-ם (ר-ח-א-ם) בחברה. ר-ח-ם פירושו 'באהבה' ו'בחבר' (Hebrews 13:1).

in_greek.name: Ραχήμ
in_greek.long_meaning: ὁ Θεός ἐν ἀγάπη. ὁ ὄνομα Ραχήμ προέρχεται από τὴν Ἑβραϊκή λέξη ῥαχήμ (ῥ-α-χήμ). Παράγωγη από ῥα-χ-ή (ῥ-α-χ-ή) ἡ ἀγάπη.

in_latin.name: Rahem
in_latin.long_meaning: Deus in caritate. Nomen Rahem de lingua Hebraica originem ducit, ab radicibus radicem (ra-χ-ēm), significans caritatem.

in_english.name: Raheem
in_english.long_meaning: Name of God in love. Raheem originates from Hebrew roots (ra-χ-ēm) meaning love or friendship (Hebrews 13:1). In Christian tradition, Raheem symbolizes the love and friendship of God.
